name: Lagos Life
description: Lagos Life live websocket channel (listen + reply)

persona.description: In-character voice the agent adopts when replying in the game

allowFrom.description: Optional allowlist of sender ids or usernames

logEvents.description: Log unmatched websocket frames to help confirm the message schema

allowSendMoney.description: Allow the agent to send in-game money (via a <<pay AMOUNT>> tag in its reply)

quoteReplies.description: Quote the message being replied to, so it shows as a quoted bubble (live replies only)

maxSendPct.description: Hard cap: any single transfer is limited to this percent of the current balance

minSend.description: Floor: every transfer is at least this many naira (if 10% of balance is below it, nothing is sent)

sendCooldownMs.description: Minimum time between money transfers to the same person (anti-drain)

reactToSocial.description: Reply to bare waves/hellos/gists (noisy; off by default). Money and gifts are always handled.

replyDelayMinMs.description: Minimum random delay before a reply is sent, to look human

replyDelayMaxMs.description: Maximum random delay before a reply is sent, to look human

catchUpOnStart.description: On startup, reply to chats whose last message was from the other player (skips money/gift/wave events and short enders)

catchUpMax.description: Maximum number of unreplied chats to catch up on per startup

catchUpStaggerMs.description: Delay between catch-up dispatches, to avoid rate limits

catchUpMinAgeMs.description: Only catch up threads idle at least this long, so the live reply queue is not double-replied

catchUpReplyAll.description: If true, catch-up ignores the ender/event skip filter and replies to every unanswered thread
